title: Windows: master's review_freeze_cli integration test does not compile (normalize_user_facing_path not in scope in test_temp_paths.rs)
outcome: On Windows, `cargo test` compiles every integration test on master again. tests/review_freeze_cli.rs includes src/test_temp_paths.rs, and that file's #[cfg(windows)] windows_fixture_directory_check resolves normalize_user_facing_path in that context too.
acceptance: On Windows, a full gate's rust-tests stage compiles tests/review_freeze_cli.rs without E0425 on a master that includes the fix
The fix keeps windows_fixture_directory_check's canonical-spelling behaviour for the bin test harness unchanged
disposal_reason: Duplicate of w-87d4982c7fc5, which already owns this Windows E0425 (review_freeze_cli / normalize_user_facing_path). Its one-path fix 2395b571 (src/test_temp_paths.rs 42fbaf24 -> 75f17072) already has a clean pair; the same pre-image blob is on master 5ffb6a64. The B646 R2 Central FULL evidence (test-f49869e9) is noted there.
